key_design_notes: Pipeline: projectReport -> buildExportPreview -> serializeReportJson / renderReportHtml. The preview measures the final sealed projection, so approved preview == decoded file contents (I09).

Privacy defaults enforced in projection, not UI: source_pdf/filename/annotations/page_renders off by default; source opt-in is verified against document.sha256/byte_length (mismatch -> ContractError SOURCE); 'carry' reuses only verified embedded assets; missing bytes downgrade to evidence-only with recorded omissions — never fabricated replayability (I11).

Denominators stay honest: checks keep produced_occurrence_count while retained_occurrence_ids prunes; a finding only exports when every reading it cites is retained (no finding rewritten to fit a selection); required context assets are retained and disclosed via ProjectionNotices.

Determinism: serializeReportJson re-emits every schema member in declared order; identical inputs give byte-identical JSON+HTML; report_id/execution.execution_id/started_at/duration_ms are the only run-timing fields and are excluded from reportDigest; exportFileName derives from mode+report_id only.

HTML is fully self-contained: fixed stylesheet + meta CSP style-src 'sha256-…' (hash derived from the same constant), default-src 'none', no scripts/forms/links/external resources; every report-controlled string escaped via T24 escapeHtml; embedded images are sanitizePng re-encodes (never stored bytes); assertScriptFreeHtml gates the final document before return.

Web feature is a structural port (ExportEngine interface) mirroring packages/reports/export member-for-member — same decoupling as state/store.ts since apps/web tsconfig cannot resolve cross-package .ts specifiers; concrete binding lands with app composition in a later task.
limitations: apps/web tsc baseline fails on missing React typings (467 errors: TS7016 react/react-jsx-runtime + TS7026 JSX.IntrinsicElements) — pre-existing across the app; features/export contributes 69 diagnostics that are all the same baseline, zero non-baseline. @types/react not installed; lockfile frozen.
ExportPanel/ExportController are not mounted in App composition — standalone module per scope; cannot be exercised in the running app until a later UI task wires the engine binding.
No ZIP/archive export and no HTML import — contract non-goals; T24 import gate unchanged.
